strings.aviso.save_mais_novo.titulo: This save is from a newer version of the game
strings.aviso.save_mais_novo.texto: The file stays safe, but NOTHING that happens in this session will be saved. Update the game to pick up where you left off.
strings.limiar.fala.1: You arrived before your first breath. There is no ground here and no sky: only the passage.
strings.limiar.fala.2: In the Threshold. Every life crosses this place before it begins, and almost no one remembers it afterward.
strings.limiar.fala.3: They call me Aethron. I keep the passage, but I did not weave it. The Weave is older than I am, and there are threads in it even I cannot read.
strings.limiar.fala.4: Threads wound into a circle that does not close. It should not be here, and it is not for me to say why it is. If you ever see it again, remember that you saw it first in this place.
strings.limiar.fala.5: It is not because of you. Everyone who passes chooses how to enter life. You are not the first, and you will not be the last.
strings.limiar.fala.6: Now choose the life you will be born into. It is not a prize or a punishment: it is only the place where you begin. What comes after is not written here.
strings.gancho.texto:
Three years have passed, and the wooden sword feels lighter in your hand. But some questions training cannot answer: the circle that does not close, which you saw in the clearing and which seems older than your own memory; the disappearance near the woods; the feeling that something, long ago, broke. In Auren, no one can say what. Maybe no one knows yet.

Here the First Existence ends. The questions stay with you.
strings.treino.trivial: {0}: too simple for what you already know; it teaches little ({1}/{2})
strings.treino.dominio: {0}: you have learned everything this move can teach you right now.
strings.treino.saturado: {0} has taught you all it could at this stage. Practice another move, or wait until you grow.
strings.atividade.olhar_o_treino: watching the training at the post
strings.dialogo.mara.aos_oito: Three years, and you can already reach the top shelf. Sometimes I still wake up thinking I'll find you at the door, like that very first morning.
strings.dialogo.daren.aos_oito: The guard post takes apprentices your age now. Tovin said you can train there: a wooden sword, and with good sense.
strings.dialogo.daren.aos_oito_primeiro_dia: Three years since that first morning when you left home not knowing where you were going. Now the guard post takes apprentices your age. Tovin said you can train there: a wooden sword, and with good sense.
strings.dialogo.borin.aos_oito_espada: Notice the workbench is at the door now? You know why. I saved something for when you grew up: a wooden sword, made right here in the forge. It swings like the others, but this one is yours. Take it to the guard post.
strings.dialogo.borin.aos_oito: Eight years old? Then you can look at the forge fire up close. Up close, not inside. Notice the workbench? I moved it to the door: it got too dark inside. The training sword stays with Tovin, at the post.
strings.dialogo.lysa.aos_oito_animal: That little critter we looked after together still shows up at my door. I think it remembers you.
strings.dialogo.lysa.aos_oito: Sera learns with me now. If you have patience with plants, you can too.
strings.dialogo.tovin.aos_oito_depois_da_busca: Three years, and the trail from that clearing still hasn't led me anywhere. You came to the edge with me and didn't run, so now you learn to defend yourself. Your training partner is right there: show me a light strike, a heavy one, a guard or a dodge, and your first spark of magic. And nobody goes back to the woods alone, understood?
strings.dialogo.tovin.aos_oito: At eight you can hold a wooden sword. Your training partner is right there: show me a light strike, a heavy one, a guard or a dodge, and your first spark of magic. And nobody goes back to the woods alone, understood?
strings.dialogo.eira.aos_oito: Today we talk about Eldoria, from before Auren existed. You and Nilo ask questions my books can't answer.
strings.dialogo.nilo.aos_oito_cumprida: When I came back from the woods, you were there, just like you promised. I don't remember where I was. Only a circle of light and a huge silence. I want to be a guard, so no one else gets lost out there.
strings.dialogo.nilo.aos_oito_quebrada: When I came back, you weren't there. It's okay. I can't explain where I was either; I only remember a circle of light. One day I'll find out.
strings.dialogo.nilo.aos_oito: Three years, and I still dream about the woods. Not about what I saw: about what I can't remember.
strings.dialogo.sera.aos_oito_cumprida: You kept that promise, and I never forgot it. Now I learn with Lysa: I want to understand the plants that heal.
strings.dialogo.sera.aos_oito_quebrada: I'm not angry about that promise anymore. But I haven't forgotten. Now I learn with Lysa; plants, at least, do what they say.
strings.dialogo.sera.aos_oito: Three years go by fast when there's something to learn. Lysa says I have a knack for herbs.
strings.dialogo.oren.aos_oito_cesto: I still use that basket you found. Three years on the road, and it hasn't torn.
strings.dialogo.oren.aos_oito: Three years on the road, and Auren's accounts have never been so tidy. You've grown, child.
strings.dialogo.maelis.aos_oito_registro_circulo: Three years, and the record is still open in my book. Nilo came back. The question didn't. And your mark is still here. I can't read it. I haven't crossed it out.
strings.dialogo.maelis.aos_oito_registro_risco: Three years, and the record is still open in my book. Nilo came back. The question didn't. And your line is still here, signing what you told me.
strings.dialogo.maelis.aos_oito_registro: Three years, and the record of the disappearance is still open in my book. Nilo came back. The question didn't.
strings.dialogo.maelis.aos_oito: The village has changed little in three years. You have changed more.
strings.nascimento.permanente: Destiny and origin are permanent: once confirmed, they can never be changed.
strings.nascimento.destino.titulo: Before you are born: what life do you arrive in?
strings.nascimento.nome.dica: Tap the name to edit it.
strings.nascimento.certeza.texto: This is the point of no return: once you confirm, no screen in the game will offer to change your destiny or origin.
strings.nascimento.erro.nome_curto: The name needs at least 2 letters.
strings.nascimento.erro.nome_longo: The name can have at most 24 letters.
strings.nascimento.erro.nome_caractere: Use letters only; spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only between two letters.
strings.destino.serena.descricao: You arrive in a calm time: a sturdy home, a table set, and few surprises.
strings.destino.serena.familia: Your family lives comfortably and has time for you.
strings.destino.serena.contexto_social: In Auren, doors stay open to your family, and there are plenty of free afternoons to learn.
strings.destino.normal.descricao: You arrive in a home like most in Auren: steady work and careful budgets.
strings.destino.normal.familia: Your family lives on what it earns, with nothing to spare and nothing missing.
strings.destino.normal.contexto_social: In Auren, the village counts on your family for errands, the market and small favors.
strings.destino.dificil.descricao: You arrive in a year of scarcity: little put aside at home and work from an early age.
strings.destino.dificil.familia: Your family stays close in tight times; every pair of hands counts.
strings.destino.dificil.contexto_social: In Auren, the neighbors help as they can, and every favor is remembered.
strings.destino.ruptura.descricao: You arrive under a strange sign: a dream that keeps returning and something out of place in the woods.
strings.destino.ruptura.familia: Your family is like the others, but it keeps a cracked amulet and a question with no answer.
strings.destino.ruptura.contexto_social: In Auren, the village takes notice of you: some kindly, others warily.
strings.origem.agricultores.descricao: People of the land: garden, season and patience.
strings.origem.agricultores.oficio: The family trade is planting, harvesting and knowing what grows.
strings.origem.artesaos.descricao: People of the workshop and the counter: what hands make, the market sells.
strings.origem.artesaos.oficio: The family trade is making, mending and trading.
strings.origem.guardioes.descricao: People of the watch: the gate, the road and the peace of the region.
strings.origem.guardioes.oficio: The family trade is guarding, patrolling and protecting.
strings.npc.mara.papel: Head of the family and home
strings.npc.daren.papel: Head of the family and trade
strings.atividade.comprar_o_dia: Buying what's needed for the day
strings.atividade.fim_do_dia_em_casa: At home, at the end of the day
strings.atividade.preparar_o_oficio: Getting ready for the day's work
strings.atividade.colher_no_bosque: Gathering at the edge of the woods
strings.missao.q02.obj.prestar_contas: Tell Daren the message was delivered
strings.missao.q03.obj.procurar_na_praca: Look for Oren's basket in the square
strings.missao.q03.obj.procurar_na_horta: Look for the basket in the garden
strings.missao.q03.obj.procurar_na_trilha: Look for the basket on the woods trail
strings.missao.q04.obj.decidir: Decide what to do with the secret
strings.missao.q07.obj.notar_a_ausencia: Find out why Nilo didn't show up
strings.missao.q07.obj.perguntar_na_vila: Ask about Nilo and tell Maelis
strings.missao.q07.obj.seguir_ate_o_bosque: Go to the woods with Tovin
strings.missao.q08.obj.achar_o_simbolo: Find the mark in the clearing
strings.cenario.casa_familia.fala: The door of home, always left ajar. Inside it smells like bread.
strings.cenario.casa_nilo.fala: Nilo's house. You can hear someone sweeping inside.
strings.cenario.casa_sera.fala: On Sera's door, a little sprig of rosemary hangs for good luck.
strings.cenario.poco.fala: The water comes up cold and clear. You take a sip.
strings.cenario.mural.fala: Village notices: market at the end of the week. If you find a lost bucket, return it to the well.
strings.cenario.mural.depois: A new paper, in Maelis's handwriting: “Nilo is missing; his bed was empty this morning. Anyone who knows something, come see me.”
strings.dialogo.opcao.oferecer_ajuda: Can I help at the forge?
strings.dialogo.opcao.perguntar_metais: How do you choose the metal?
strings.dialogo.opcao.perguntar_comercio: Where do your things come from?
strings.dialogo.opcao.perguntar_vila: What's it like looking after the village?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q01.obj.falar_com_fa: Good morning! What are we doing today?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q02.titulo: Can I help with the trade too?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q02.obj.cumprir_tare: Daren sent a message for you.
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q02.obj.prestar_cont: I gave the message to Oren!
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q03.obj.procurar_na_: I'm looking for your basket here in the square.
Nilo, did you see a basket on the trail?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q04.titulo: What is it? You can tell me.
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q04.obj.ouvir_o_pedi: Wait... Nilo goes to the woods by himself?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q04.obj.sustentar_a_: Nilo, I have to tell you what I decided.
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q05.titulo: Do you look after animals too?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q05.obj.buscar_ajuda: I found a hurt little critter near the woods. Will you help?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q05.obj.tratar_o_ani: Shall we take care of it together?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q06.titulo: Can I see the forge up close?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q06.obj.entrar_na_fe: May I come in? I promise not to touch anything.
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q06.obj.guardar_o_se: Don't worry: that secret stays with me.
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q07.obj.notar_a_ause: Nilo didn't show up today. Did something happen?
strings.dialogo.fala.missao.q07.obj.seguir_ate_o: I'll go to the woods with you.
strings.dialogo.opcao.evento.q04_promessa_cumpri: Keep the promise: keep the secret
strings.dialogo.opcao.evento.q04_promessa_quebra: Break the promise: tell a grown-up
strings.dialogo.mara.primeiro_dia: Awake, my dear? Come here, let me see that face. Today you can go out to the street, but talk to Daren before you go.
strings.dialogo.mara.primeiro_dia_agricultores: Awake, my dear? Farm folk rise with the rooster, and you're already up: the cabbage patch will be glad to see you. Today you can go out to the street, but talk to Daren before you go.
strings.dialogo.mara.primeiro_dia_artesaos: Awake, my dear? Hands already reaching for a tool, just like Daren in the workshop. Let me see that face before the market opens. Today you can go out to the street, but talk to Daren before you go.
strings.dialogo.mara.primeiro_dia_guardioes: Awake, my dear? In a watch family nobody sleeps late, and you're already up with your eye on the door. Today you can go out to the street, but talk to Daren before you go.
strings.dialogo.mara.nilo_sumiu: Nilo's mother stopped by and could barely speak. If you go help look, stay close to the grown-ups. Promise?
strings.dialogo.mara.noite: It's dark already, my dear. At night we stay close to home.
strings.dialogo.mara.em_casa: Hi, my dear. You can play in the village, but the edge of the woods is your limit. Deal?
strings.dialogo.mara.sobre_familia: It's the three of us and this house. Daren looks after the trade, I look after the rest, and you look after growing up.
strings.dialogo.daren.primeiro_dia: Good morning. The sun is up, and so are you. Today you get to know the village on your own two feet.
strings.dialogo.daren.tarefa_pendente: A task given is a task done. Take the message to Oren and come back to tell me.
strings.dialogo.daren.tarefa_cumprida: You went, you delivered it, and you came back to tell me. It was a small task, but it was yours. I'll remember that.
strings.dialogo.daren.noite: The day is over. Whoever rests well works well.
strings.dialogo.daren.em_casa: I'm putting the tools of the trade in order. You can look. Touching, only when I show you how.
strings.dialogo.daren.sobre_oficio: A trade is what we do every day, rain or shine. Ours puts food on this table.
strings.dialogo.borin.noite: Forge is out. At night I only listen to the square. If it's trade talk, keep your voice down: the fire sleeps, but I don't.
strings.dialogo.borin.noite_forja: Forge is out. Iron is checked by light, and at night even the fire doesn't help. Off to bed. In the morning we'll work the bellows.
strings.dialogo.borin.reencontro: Look who's back. You saw what you saw here and kept your mouth shut. In my forge that has a name: your word.
strings.dialogo.borin.primeira_vez: Hot iron is no toy. If you want to stay, keep your eyes open and your hands behind you.
strings.dialogo.borin.sobre_metais: Iron takes a beating. Copper takes a shape. Neither forgives haste.
strings.dialogo.borin.aceitou: Then grab that bucket and don't touch anything that glows. Let's see what you're made of.
strings.dialogo.borin.na_forja: Bellows. Pump until I say enough. One, two, three... Enough. Now hand me that piece. The reforged one.
strings.dialogo.borin.de_novo: Again. It's not wrong. I just haven't checked it twice yet.
strings.dialogo.borin.gabarito: Set the piece against the gauge. It slips loose at the second notch, fits snug at the third, and locks at the fourth. Read that mark for me: how far does it go?
strings.dialogo.borin.leu_certo: Third. Just as I said. I only wanted to hear it from another mouth. ... My eyes can't read a fine mark anymore. No one in the village knows that. No one.
strings.dialogo.lysa.chegar_devagar: My hat is over it: darkness calms it. Come slowly, stop beside it and count three breaths. It is counting yours.
strings.dialogo.lysa.no_bosque: Step slowly here. The plants at the edge of the woods spook easier than animals.
strings.dialogo.lysa.depois_do_animal: The little one is already putting its paw down. You had a gentle hand with it, and no one teaches that.
strings.dialogo.lysa.em_casa: Come in, but don't blow on the leaves. I'm sorting what heals from what only smells nice.
strings.dialogo.lysa.sobre_ervas: This one lowers a fever. That one soothes a tummy ache. And none of them goes in your mouth unless I say so.
strings.dialogo.lysa.sobre_bosque: The woods give a lot to those who ask for little. Past the entrance, even I don't go without Tovin.
strings.dialogo.lysa.sobre_limiar: That word I've only heard in the stories of old folk. What it means, no one here can tell you.
strings.dialogo.tovin.rastro_no_bosque: I found small footprints on the trail, going into the woods. None coming back. If you come with me, step where I step.
strings.dialogo.tovin.depois_da_busca: The trail ended at the clearing, and I go back there every day. You came to the edge with me and didn't run. I don't forget who stays.
strings.dialogo.tovin.noite: Night rounds. A child out on the street at this hour, I take by the hand to their front door.
strings.dialogo.tovin.no_posto: From here I can see the gate and the trail: who comes in and who goes out. You've been looking at the woods a lot.
strings.dialogo.tovin.sobre_bosque: Up to the entrance, fine. Past it, only with me. The woods aren't bad. They just don't give warning.
strings.dialogo.eira.lugar_vazio: Nilo didn't come to class. Yesterday he asked me what's beyond the clearing, and I said I didn't know. I should have asked him why he wanted to know.
strings.dialogo.eira.noite: At night I read the notices on the board. Old paper tells stories too, did you know?
strings.dialogo.eira.na_aula: You came just in time for today's question: why does the river never flow backward? Think about it and answer me tomorrow.
strings.dialogo.eira.sobre_historia: Auren lies in the kingdom of Eldoria, which is older than any grandmother here. There are ruins out there no one knows who built. Not even me, yet.
strings.dialogo.nilo.promessa_cumprida: Sera said you know my secret and didn't tell anyone! Then you're one of mine. One day I'll take you there.
strings.dialogo.nilo.promessa_quebrada: You told. Now everyone keeps looking at me. I thought you were my friend.
strings.dialogo.nilo.na_escola: Psst! Eira is looking. After class we'll go to the edge of the woods, okay?
strings.dialogo.nilo.chamando: Come on! I know a spot at the edge of the woods that nobody knows. Let's go?
strings.dialogo.nilo.combinado: Yay! But it's a secret, okay? Last one there is a toad!
strings.dialogo.sera.promessa_cumprida: You kept the secret. I was watching to see if you'd tell, and you didn't. I don't doubt you anymore.
strings.dialogo.sera.promessa_quebrada: You promised and you told. I remember everything, and I won't forget this. I'm not telling you anything else.
strings.dialogo.sera.o_pedido: Listen, and don't spread it: Nilo keeps going to the edge of the woods alone, and he made me swear to keep it secret. Now you know too. Promise you won't tell anyone?
strings.dialogo.sera.na_praca: Eira said I read better than Nilo, and I bet I run faster than you. Wanna see? Race you to the notice board!
strings.dialogo.sera.nilo_sumiu_cumprida: We kept the secret, and now he's gone. If we had told... I don't know. And I hate not knowing.
strings.dialogo.sera.nilo_sumiu_quebrada: The grown-ups already knew about the woods, because you told. And he went anyway. So it didn't help at all, did it?
strings.dialogo.oren.viu_nilo: Nilo? He passed by early, with a bundle under his arm: bread, by the smell. Whoever carries bread doesn't plan to be back for lunch.
strings.dialogo.oren.cesto_achado: My basket came back in one piece, thanks to you. A favor I don't forget: I write it down.
strings.dialogo.oren.recado_feito: You brought Daren's message just right. A child who delivers messages grows into someone people trust.
strings.dialogo.oren.noite: I'm closing the accounts. A coin counted at night doesn't vanish by day.
strings.dialogo.oren.na_banca: Looking is free. Taking isn't. Need something, or just peeking?
strings.dialogo.oren.sobre_comercio: Everything that reaches Auren comes by the south road and passes through my hands. I buy low, sell fair and sleep well.
strings.dialogo.maelis.assinar: Before sunrise, an empty bed. He asked what lies beyond the clearing. He carried bread. Noted. Whoever tells, signs. Can't write? Make a mark of your own.
strings.dialogo.maelis.ausencia: Nilo's mother was here before sunrise: his bed was empty this morning. I don't want a fuss before I'm certain. Ask Eira and Oren, and tell me what you hear.
strings.dialogo.maelis.depois_da_busca: You helped more than many grown-ups. The notice is still on the board, and the search goes on. That record I will not close.
strings.dialogo.maelis.noite: At this hour I record the day's decisions. And children should be home already.
strings.dialogo.maelis.no_mural: Careful with the notices, the ink is still wet. If you have a complaint, speak slowly so I can write it down.
strings.dialogo.maelis.sobre_vila: Auren works because everyone knows their part. My job is to remind those who forget.
strings.dialogo.opcao.mostrar_o_de_casa: Look what I brought from home.
strings.dialogo.mara.destino_serena: A free afternoon is for coming back with a story, my dear. Just one, and I'll listen to all of it. And the woods, only up to the entrance. Deal?
strings.dialogo.mara.destino_normal: On market day you're my helper: you carry the light things, I carry the rest. And the woods, only up to the entrance. Deal?
strings.dialogo.mara.destino_dificil: The cloth at home is patched, my dear, but our deal is whole: the woods, only up to the entrance. Deal?
strings.dialogo.mara.destino_ruptura: Some people look at you a lot, my dear. Let them look. You look at the entrance to the woods, and stop there. Deal?
strings.dialogo.daren.destino_serena: No rush in this house. A message given is a message returned. And on the way back, look at the village: it's a task too.
strings.dialogo.daren.destino_normal: Today it's a message. Tomorrow it's the whole village. Whoever carries one carries them all.
strings.dialogo.daren.destino_dificil: Here a message isn't a lesson, it's food. A message that arrives early fills the table early.
strings.dialogo.daren.destino_ruptura: Out on the road there are people who take notice of you. Their looking is up to them. Walking beside me is up to you.
strings.dialogo.daren.origem_agricultores: I made it, by eye, same as my own. Then Borin set the edge right. The eye makes it, the hand checks it.
strings.dialogo.daren.origem_artesaos: I made it, by eye, same as mine. I took it to Borin to check, and he saved a spot for you in the workshop. The eye makes it, the hand checks it.
strings.dialogo.daren.origem_guardioes: I made it, by eye, to the size of mine. Borin says it's out of measure. The eye makes it, the hand checks it.
strings.dialogo.borin.destino_serena: Let me see that toy. Hm. Here, see, the carving came out crooked. Pretty, but crooked. Visitors notice. Iron, only the second time.
strings.dialogo.borin.destino_normal: You're a messenger, aren't you? A message for me, repeat it twice. Word for word. A crooked message doesn't go in the forge.
strings.dialogo.borin.destino_dificil: Give me that knife. Edge worn away. There, redone. That's no favor, it's village iron. Whoever already works should carry a good edge.
strings.dialogo.borin.destino_ruptura: That amulet there. Let me see. ...No. That's not iron I know. What I don't know, I don't measure.
strings.dialogo.borin.origem_agricultores: That sickle I know. It passed over this anvil. The proof is right here on the rim, see? Two strikes and it came out right.
strings.dialogo.borin.origem_artesaos: Light hammer, firm handle. So you already know how to hold one. With you I skip the chatter: here I charge more.
strings.dialogo.borin.origem_guardioes: Let me measure. One, two, three fingers. Out of measure. For play, it'll do. For training, no.
strings.dialogo.lysa.origem_agricultores: Step slowly. You know the garden. At the edge, no one plants: here we only gather what it gives.
strings.dialogo.lysa.origem_guardioes: With Tovin you learned to step. With me, to stop. Stop. Count three breaths, and only then look.
strings.dialogo.lysa.destino_serena: In the afternoon I go to the edge, and you have a free afternoon. Come kneel beside me. Before you touch anything, count three breaths.
strings.dialogo.lysa.destino_normal: You already know how to fetch and carry. So learn the first thing: a wound gets washed before anything else. Clean water, and only then the rest.
strings.dialogo.lysa.destino_dificil: A lean year, I know. Today I'm not teaching medicine. I'm teaching what you can eat from the edge: this one fills the belly, that one doesn't.
strings.dialogo.lysa.destino_ruptura: Look at this bunch, the ninth one. It grew at the edge, but it isn't from the edge. I don't know its name. Have you seen this plant before?
strings.dialogo.tovin.origem_guardioes: A guard's household, eh? Then your rounds are with me: from the square to the post, one step behind. Who comes in, who goes out. Understood?
strings.dialogo.tovin.destino_serena: You have a free afternoon, and in the afternoon I'm at the woods' entrance. Stay on the line and shout if anyone passes. Understood?
strings.dialogo.tovin.destino_normal: You walk the whole village with messages. So help me count: did you see anyone heading north today?
strings.dialogo.tovin.destino_dificil: Frayed rope isn't thrown away. Tie a knot before the weak strand, like this. Now the load doesn't catch on the fray. Understood?
strings.dialogo.tovin.destino_ruptura: You look at the woods the way they look back at us. I don't like it. With you it's this way: from the entrance, back home. Understood?
strings.dialogo.eira.destino_serena: You have a free afternoon, so take today's question home: why does the shadow change sides? No rush: the answer can wait, did you know?
strings.dialogo.eira.destino_normal: When you carry a message, notice if there's anything written along the way and bring me a letter. Which one will you find first, I wonder?
strings.dialogo.eira.destino_dificil: Whoever works by day learns by night. The lantern is the same. Will you stop by the board after sunset? One notice a night, we'll read it together.
strings.dialogo.eira.destino_ruptura: Will you sit in the morning circle with us? Nobody asked me to, I'm inviting you myself. The slate has room, and today you write first.
strings.dialogo.nilo.origem_guardioes: Psst! You go around with Tovin, right? I wasn't copying him, no. After class we'll go to the edge, okay?
strings.dialogo.nilo.destino_serena: Again today? You have the whole afternoon, and the afternoon belongs to the edge. Come on!
strings.dialogo.nilo.destino_normal: A message again? The message can wait. The woods can't. Come on!
strings.dialogo.nilo.destino_dificil: You already work? Then you can already go past the line. Come with me, come on!
strings.dialogo.nilo.destino_ruptura: You dream, right? I bet in your dream you see the other side of the woods. Will you show me?
strings.dialogo.sera.destino_serena: You have the whole afternoon. I have the market. And even so it's three to one for me in reading. It's written!
strings.dialogo.sera.destino_normal: In class, at the market and on errands: everything's a race. It's two all. To the notice board, to break the tie!
strings.dialogo.sera.destino_dificil: You don't go to class, so we can't compete at reading. But we can at words. When you promise, the word is yours. The letters are mine.
strings.dialogo.sera.destino_ruptura: Tell me again what you saw. Slowly, so I can write it. It's not in any story. So it'll be in mine.
strings.dialogo.oren.destino_serena: That toy didn't pass through my hands: someone here made it for you. What has no price I don't sell, child.
strings.dialogo.oren.destino_normal: That canteen I know. Leather from outside, stitching from outside. It went from my hand to your house on a market day.
strings.dialogo.oren.destino_dificil: That blade came through that gate before you were born. A worn knife is a knife that has worked: worth more than a new one, and no one pays for that.
strings.dialogo.oren.destino_ruptura: That amulet... Copper? No. Stone? Not that either. That didn't pass through my hands, child. And nothing enters Auren without passing.
strings.dialogo.oren.origem_agricultores: Old iron, new sickle. The iron I brought; Borin did the rest.
strings.dialogo.oren.origem_artesaos: Iron head from outside, handle from here. A counter family already knows the rule, so I needn't say it.
strings.dialogo.oren.origem_guardioes: Auren wood, made here. I earned nothing from that one.
strings.dialogo.maelis.destino_serena: Your household signs everything on time. Witness: my book. Noted. If you have a complaint, speak slowly so I can write it.
strings.dialogo.maelis.destino_normal: You already carry the village's messages. A delivered message, I note it. Witness: whoever received it. That is how the village trusts.
strings.dialogo.maelis.destino_dificil: Your household is here in the book, in the lean year. A noted favor is not a debt: it's the village remembering itself.
strings.dialogo.maelis.destino_ruptura: Some people take too much notice of you. I take notice in the book, and carefully. Whoever gives you a sideways look, tell me. I'll note it.
strings.salto.idade: You go from {0} to {1} years old.
strings.salto.encerra: Optional quests left unfinished, which end with the leap:
strings.salto.vinculos: Bonds that change: Nilo and Sera will grow too, with other hopes and another routine.
strings.salto.sobrevive: Stays with you: name, destiny, origin, life history, promises, the trust of the people of Auren, coins and items. The leap erases nothing.
strings.salto.certeza.texto:
Are you sure?

Three years will pass all at once. What was on the list comes to an end, and you can't go back to being five.
strings.titulo.nova_vida.texto: {0}'s life will be erased: destiny, quests, friendships and everything that happened in Auren. This can't be undone.
